{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Opening post-secondary education to virtually everyone was one of the most profound changes in American society in the last half-century.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Competition among institutions has been the key to the success of opening post-secondary education to virtually everyone.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The higher education system in the United States is the best in the world.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In the United States, achievement can count for more than money or social status in higher education.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The technological revolution and the global economy require continued expansion of the extent and excellence of higher education.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Governor Bush and congressional Republicans have given priority to programs that increase access to higher education for qualified students.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Education savings accounts are the ideal combination of minimal red tape and maximum consumer choice.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Congressional Republicans passed legislation to allow tax-free distributions from state pre-paid tuition plans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Congressional Republicans passed legislation to enhance the tax deduction for student loans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Congressional Republicans passed legislation to make it more practicable for employers to provide educational assistance to train workers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"That legislation was vetoed.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Next year, a Republican president will sign that legislation into law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
